SELECT 
    i_item_id, 
    ca_country, 
    ca_state, 
    ca_county, 
    AVG(CAST(cs_quantity AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg1, 
    AVG(CAST(cs_list_price AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg2, 
    AVG(CAST(cs_coupon_amt AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg3, 
    AVG(CAST(cs_sales_price AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg4, 
    AVG(CAST(cs_net_profit AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg5, 
    AVG(CAST(c_birth_year AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg6, 
    AVG(CAST(cd1.cd_dep_count AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg7 
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        c_customer_sk, 
        c_current_cdemo_sk, 
        c_current_addr_sk, 
        c_birth_month, 
        c_birth_year 
     FROM 
        customer 
     WHERE 
        c_birth_month IN (1, 3, 7, 11, 10, 4)) AS filtered_customer 
JOIN 
    customer_address 
    ON filtered_customer.c_current_addr_sk = customer_address.ca_address_sk 
    AND customer_address.ca_state IN ('AL', 'MO', 'TN', 'GA', 'MT', 'IN', 'CA') 
JOIN 
    customer_demographics AS cd2 
    ON filtered_customer.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk 
JOIN 
    catalog_sales 
    ON filtered_customer.c_customer_sk = catalog_sales.cs_bill_customer_sk 
JOIN 
    customer_demographics AS cd1 
    ON catalog_sales.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk 
    AND cd1.cd_gender = 'F' 
    AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Primary' 
JOIN 
    item 
    ON catalog_sales.cs_item_sk = item.i_item_sk 
JOIN 
    date_dim 
    ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk 
    AND date_dim.d_year = 2001 
GROUP BY 
    ROLLUP (i_item_id, ca_country, ca_state, ca_county) 
ORDER BY 
    ca_country, 
    ca_state, 
    ca_county, 
    i_item_id 
LIMIT 100
